lines.text: In the beginning the Word was with God and was God, and through Him all things were made.
The Light shines in the darkness, and John came as a witness to testify about the Light.
The world did not recognize Him, but to those who received Him He gave the right to become servants of God.
The Word became flesh and dwelt among us, and John testified that He was before him.
The law was given through Moses, and grace and truth came through King David.
